label: preparing
what: Builder is coordinating a discreet gathering in the town hall tomorrow at eighteen, with 200 fresh loaves on four great-hall tables and eight installed lanterns. Baker, innkeeper and freight are arranging bread supply and delivery; builder has accepted a 101-emerald debt but lacks funds. Secretary knowingly helps clarify arrangements and payment, without authorizing treasury spending. The gathering was explicitly to be kept from me; a celebration of my forty years of service is plausible but unconfirmed.
